# wallix.bastion.encryption

Set up or change the encryption passphrase of a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.1.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Set up the encryption of the secrets of a Bastion, protect it with a passphrase, or change that passphrase.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_encryption` Terraform resource.
- The encryption is a singleton that cannot be deleted, so the module only offers [`state=present`](#parameter-state).
- The Bastion never returns the passphrase, so the module decides from the encryption state it reports ([`encryption.seal_state`](#return-encryption-seal-state) and [`encryption.encryption_mode`](#return-encryption-encryption-mode)) and from the options given. The encryption is set up when the Bastion needs it. A passphrase is added when the Bastion has none (`unprotected`) and [`new_passphrase`](#parameter-new-passphrase) is not empty. The passphrase is changed when [`current_passphrase`](#parameter-current-passphrase) is set and differs from [`new_passphrase`](#parameter-new-passphrase). Otherwise nothing is sent.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-current-passphrase"></a>**current_passphrase** | `str` | Current passphrase, to change it to [`new_passphrase`](#parameter-new-passphrase).<br>Remove it from the task once the passphrase is changed. The Bastion refuses a later run with a current passphrase that is no longer valid. |
| <a id="parameter-new-passphrase"></a>**new_passphrase** | `str` / required | Passphrase to protect the encryption with. `""` sets up the encryption without a passphrase (not recommended). |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Only `present` is supported. The encryption cannot be removed.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- A sealed Bastion (after a reboot, with a passphrase) must be unlocked first; the module fails.
- Losing the passphrase of a sealed Bastion makes its secrets unrecoverable. Keep it in a vault.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Set up the encryption of a new Bastion with a passphrase
  wallix.bastion.encryption:
    new_passphrase: "{{ vault_bastion_passphrase }}"

- name: Rotate the passphrase
  wallix.bastion.encryption:
    current_passphrase: "{{ vault_bastion_old_passphrase }}"
    new_passphrase: "{{ vault_bastion_passphrase }}"
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-action"></a>**action** | `str` | What was (or would be) done.<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Choices: `none`, `setup`, `change_passphrase`<br><br>Sample: `change_passphrase` |
| <a id="return-encryption"></a>**encryption** | `dict` | The encryption state as returned by the Bastion API after the change.<br>In check mode, the expected state.<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-encryption) |
| <a id="return-encryption-enabled"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **enabled** | `bool` | Whether the encryption is set up and unlocked, like the `enabled` attribute of the Terraform data source.<br><br>Returned: always |
| <a id="return-encryption-encryption"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **encryption** | `str` | Encryption state (API v3.8), `ready` once set up.<br><br>Returned: with API v3.8 |
| <a id="return-encryption-encryption-mode"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **encryption_mode** | `str` | `need_setup`, `unprotected`, `passphrase`, or `[hidden]` (API v3.12).<br><br>Returned: with API v3.12 |
| <a id="return-encryption-seal-state"></a>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;↳ **seal_state** | `str` | `need_setup`, `sealed` or `unsealed` (API v3.12).<br><br>Returned: with API v3.12 |

<a id="sample-encryption"></a>

### Sample of `encryption`

```yaml
enabled: true
encryption_mode: passphrase
seal_state: unsealed
```
